metas.name: Taken: Natalee Holloway
metas.description: Explores the 2005 disappearance of 18-year-old Natalee Holloway during a graduation trip to Aruba and her mother Beth's two-decade search for answers and justice. Available on Netflix in 4K.

metas.name: Swipe Right on the Devil
metas.description: Revisits the 2017 murder of 24-year-old Sydney Loofe, who disappeared and was later found dead after going on a Tinder date with Bailey Boswell. Available on Hulu in 1080p.

metas.name: A Killer Story
metas.description: Investigative journalist Joe Sexton looks into a 2002 double homicide case in Kansas after receiving thousands of emails from Eileen Umbehr, a homemaker turned citizen sleuth. Eileen and her husband Keen are convinced that Dana Chandler, the woman accused of killing her ex-husband and his girlfriend, did not commit the crime and devote their lives to fighting for Chandler's innocence. Available on HBO Max in 4K.

metas.name: The Serial Killer Connection
metas.description: The ex-wife and survivor of serial killer Richard "Marc" Evonitz unite to uncover his untold life and crimes and as they dig deeper, they confront the chilling possibility that the full scope of his crimes has yet to be revealed. Available on HBO Max in 1080p.

metas.name: Chilean Mine Rescue: Race Against Time
metas.description: Following a mining accident in northern Chile, 33 miners are trapped deep underground. As the search for them begins, the men are fighting for their lives under extreme conditions. Available on Hulu in 4K.

metas.name: Africa Earth's Wild Home
metas.description: Captures unprecedented behaviors, examine continental forces, and highlight life's adaptations. Features National Geographic Explorers and scientists working to understand and protect Africa's wildlife. Available on Hulu in 4K.

metas.name: World's Most Evil Women
metas.description: World's Most Evil Women unmasks those who traded compassion for cruelty, committing acts so horrific they shattered entire communities. Available on Prime Video in 1080p.

metas.name: Cars That Changed History
metas.description:
Cars That Changed History is a 2026 documentary docuseries airing on National Geographic.

Format: 1-season docuseries consisting of 6 episodes exploring engineering breakthroughs, historic rivalries, and the social impact of iconic vehicles. Available on Hulu in 1080p.
